reason: Writing the stage-1 plan required finding the test and typecheck commands for this monorepo by grepping package.json. These commands and the plan locations are repo facts a future session would otherwise rediscover each time.

The loaded skill says to narrow web tests with paths after `--`, but in this episode `pnpm --filter @cs/web test -- <files>` ignored the file filter and ran the whole suite. The working focused form was `pnpm --filter @cs/web exec vitest run <files>`. Fixing the instruction stops the next session from paying for a full run.

In a fresh worktree, `tsc --noEmit` fails with a LayoutProps error that is not a code defect. Running `npx next typegen` in apps/web clears it (tsc rc=0 after). The skill does not mention this, so every new worktree wastes a debugging round.
Drizzle generate picks up whatever schema diff exists. A migration that holds only the intended change has to be checked by reading it, since the generate command itself does not confirm it.
